mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW (CONTENT_ID, USER_ID, REVIEW_BODY, IS_SPOILER, TRACK_ID, YOUTUBE_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, CREATED_AT, DEL_YN) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{userId}, #{reviewBody}, #{isSpoiler}, #{trackId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{youtubeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startTime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{endTime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.USER_ID, R.CONTENT_ID, R.REVIEW_BODY, R.IS_SPOILER, R.TRACK_ID, R.YOUTUBE_ID, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.REVIEW_ID = #{value} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.USER_ID, R.CONTENT_ID, R.REVIEW_BODY, R.IS_SPOILER, R.TRACK_ID, R.YOUTUBE_ID, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.CONTENT_ID = #{value} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.USER_ID, R.CONTENT_ID, R.REVIEW_BODY, R.IS_SPOILER, R.TRACK_ID, R.YOUTUBE_ID, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND (R.CREATED_AT < #{cursorCreatedAt} OR (R.CREATED_AT = #{cursorCreatedAt} AND R.REVIEW_ID < #{cursorReviewId}))
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.USER_ID, R.CONTENT_ID, R.REVIEW_BODY, R.IS_SPOILER, R.TRACK_ID, R.YOUTUBE_ID, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW_LIKE RL WHERE RL.REVIEW_ID = R.REVIEW_ID) as LIKE_COUNT FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE 1=1
AND ( LIKE_COUNT < #{cursorLikeCount} OR (LIKE_COUNT = #{cursorLikeCount} AND CREATED_AT < #{cursorCreatedAt}) OR (LIKE_COUNT = #{cursorLikeCount} AND CREATED_AT = #{cursorCreatedAt} AND REVIEW_ID < #{cursorReviewId}) )
ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, CREATED_AT DESC, REVIEW_ID DESC FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
